paragraphs.text: Devotion does not wait for permission. Nobody has to meditate first, chant first, or finish any preparation: it can dawn for anyone, right away. And it keeps you young — drinking love’s nectar washes off the grey dust that the worlds roads leave on you.

Why is that legitimate? Because every being loves its own self, and the self simply is consciousness. So love aimed at the Lord stands on its own nature — nothing else needed. And knowing this, really drowning in it, is itself the conquest.

Then follow the consequences. The whole world turns into ritual ground. Joy, sorrow and bewilderment all become the road. The only scam is thinking God lives only in special states. And the mind that started out as a mere seed of pain ripens, watered by devotion, into the great fruit of freedom.
